reviews.review:
My have not landed well at the time of release. Maybe feelings where to high for expectations.

The story at points is flat, some quests are clearly fetch quests and pointless to the narrative...

Comparable to the original Mass Effect 1 (got most attention after Mass Effect 2), the Story of Ryder and the milky way really opened up the possibility of a new narrative of a inter galactic war with the Kett an empire that had mastered Dark Space travel.

Yes Much of the milk way races and references of the OG Shepard story is gone. Yes the companion customization from Mass Effect 3 is Gone. Yes Ryder can change and hybrid roles on the fly. Yes it is buggy and the animations are bad at times. Yes all the issues of the Milky way found their way to Helios.

Yes the Quarians, geth, batarians, etc. are missing, yes the archon was a blan villian in the end.

After 10 years, taking Andromeda as it was intended. As a new starting point to expand the Mass Effect outside of the Milky way and the Reaper narrative. It did a solid job.

As an OG fan of Mass Effect this game gets:

3/5 without mods
4/5 with mods

If studios would use their massive data to KEEP features and build off of them. Andromeda would have been better. There was no reason for no companion customization at all.

I tried to like it. So many fetch quests, bad UI, long dry spells of running around talking to boring characters, snoozy combat. Overall just not up to the standards of the og series.

I am a recent fan of the series, and I really have gotten into the game. the only gripe I have about it is that I have to run it on dx11, and even then it doesn't completely stop my game from crashing from time to time. wouldn't say it's the best, but its worth a try
